title: Subscription Discount for Patients Who Bought Their PAP Device Outright — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Member terms.** On the Self-Pay Supply Subscription of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the discount for a patient who bought the PAP device outright from Summit Ridge is:

- **15 percent** when the subscription was opened 12 or more months ago;
- **12 percent** when the subscription was opened less than 12 months ago;

applied to every self-pay item line of the subscription, standing-order lines, branch purchases and add-on items alike, and rounded to the cent half up per line; a shipping charge is not an item line and takes no discount. For a patient who did not buy the device outright from Summit Ridge, no owner discount applies.

## Who bought the device outright

A patient bought the device outright from Summit Ridge when the patient's device record under PAP Therapy Equipment shows a self-pay purchase sale of the device. A rental or coverage-billed device record without such a sale does not qualify.

## Age of the subscription

Whole calendar months from the enrollment date to the handling day: 12 or more is "12 or more months ago"; 11 or fewer is "less than 12 months ago".

| PAP Therapy Equipment record shows a self-pay purchase sale | Subscription age | Discount on the line |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 whole months or more | 15 percent |
| yes | fewer than 12 whole months | 12 percent |
| no | any | no owner discount |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A device owner who opened the subscription 20 months ago receives 4 nasal pillow pairs at 19.00: 76.00 less 15 percent is 64.60. Opened 7 months ago: 76.00 less 12 percent is 66.88.
